item.title: Daily digest — 2026-07-30
item.description:
Our open-source research community has seen exciting progress recently, with notable updates in the scienceverse/metacheck and marton-balazs-kovacs/tenzing projects. The scienceverse/metacheck repository now includes statistical output for the Lakens method, enhancing its analytical capabilities, thanks to the addition made in the `data_check` branch. Meanwhile, the marton-balazs-kovacs/tenzing project has seen updates to both its website and core functionality, with a new site build for version 0.4.1 and a modification to the success alert title in `sweet_alert.js`. These changes demonstrate the community's focus on both improving research tools and enhancing user experience. As our projects continue to evolve, we celebrate the connections between them and the collective progress being made, ultimately strengthening our research ecosystem. With these updates, we look forward to seeing the impact of these enhancements on our community's research endeavors.

item.title: coarse: 1 commit today
item.description:
Davidvandijcke/coarse

Work was done on three branches: `feat/latest-models-deep-literature`, `dev`, and `main`. On the `feat/latest-models-deep-literature` branch, a feature was added to "refresh models and add deep literature search", as part of a review. The `dev` branch saw a fix to "re-enable Fable 5 in the model picker". Similarly, the `main` branch also received a fix to "re-enable Fable 5 in the model picker", which is identical to the change made on the `dev` branch.
